target_customer: B2B sales teams and SDRs that cold call from a CRM or sales engagement tool
problem: Outbound reps lose time dialing one line at a time and get little coaching during live calls.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat per month (Power $99.99, Power + Parallel $149.99, Business plan adds coaching)
product_category: Power and parallel dialer with AI call coaching (Chrome extension)

founders.name: Ajinkya Nene
education: MIT, master's and bachelor's in computer science

founders.name: Craig Bonnoit
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page; experience in real-time autonomous systems and derivative pricing.

competitors.name: Nooks
competitors.what: Parallel dialer with a virtual salesfloor

technical_complexity.rationale: Telephony, a browser extension that works inside several CRMs, and real-time call transcription and coaching are standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: CRM integrations and price positioning help, but parallel dialing and AI coaching are offered by funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC launch post compares against HubSpot's native power dialer, which requires Sales Hub Enterprise; no source describes a dated incumbent move.

market_need_then: The company's own pages cite sales teams wanting more dialing volume inside their existing CRM, with G2 and Chrome Web Store ratings as later evidence of adoption.

branding.domain_note: Uses trellus.ai; no domain history found.

brand_strength.rationale: Trademark records and other companies named Trellus or Trellis suggest the name is confusable; G2 and Chrome store ratings exist but no press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Real-time conversation guidance (started 2020 per the About page snippet)
pivots.why: After joining YC the team focused on sales calls, per the About page snippet.

outcome_analysis: Trellus is active with a team of 8 and a product that adds parallel dialing, coaching and SOC 2 compliance, with customer logos on its site. No acquisition, layoffs or shutdown was found, and funding is not verified, so the trajectory is only partly visible and no strong success or failure factor can be assigned.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators list about $500K pre-seed from YC and Soma Capital in Mar 2022, seen in one search snippet only. The About page lists extra founding team names (Dom Odoguardi, Andrew Geng) in a snippet that conflicts with the YC page, so only the two YC founders are recorded. Competitor sources are the company's own compare pages, which are undated and later than the batch; Nooks and Orum are named in company launch post titles. Name origin and logo not found. Completeness pass: the pre-seed rests on aggregators only (Bouncewatch dates it 2022-03-22; VCBacked says 500K, Extruct says 125K), so amount is left null. The company About page lists Ajinkya Nene and Craig Bonnoit as founders.
